lecture_title: Vector Spaces, Superposition, and the First Quantum Postulates

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: The displacement, resolution scale, and velocity-error estimate are simultaneously visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The error in the velocity is plus or minus delta divided by t.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The conjugated product is the dominant and least-obstructed board content.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The complex conjugate of this product.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: All componentwise entries in the column addition are visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: We can add these two column vectors.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: The two noncollinear vectors are clear and the coefficient expression remains partly visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: I could draw another vector in here.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: The completed function-to-ket mapping is clear.
assets.caption_hint: function represented as an abstract ket
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Psi of x is another vector.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Both the ket-to-bra map and the scalar-conjugation rule are unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: It has to be alpha star.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: The integral and conjugated bra function are visible with limited hand occlusion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The inner product is given by the integral.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: The component formula and reconstructed basis expansion are complete and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The coefficient is the inner product with the basis vector.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: The sum of squared amplitudes and the state norm are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This is just the inner product of cc with cc.

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The two defining linearity rules are the dominant board content.
assets.caption_hint: homogeneity and additivity of a linear operator
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The rotation of the sum is the sum of the rotations.
